issues.detail: v6 hard-coded the equal-centre pairing test. The canonical train contains 0 uncentred same-colour pairs, so overlap/{trim_any,trim_same,span_any,span_same} fit all 3 train demos exactly. On the canonical test they bridge col 25 rows 15-19, which the label does not. v6 answered the canonical query from an undemonstrated parameter. On native pairs the overlap reading differs from the label in about 24% of pairs (61/250 in rival_probe).

With the v7 family, solver and gate both refuse the canonical query in all 16 variants, so the standard audit.py fails at the fixture stage (standard-audit-v7-f3b10344.json). This is a context shortfall, not intrinsic ambiguity. One added native demonstration fixes it: native generate(**params) in proposed-extra-demo-f3b10344.json. Original pairs are unchanged, following the df8cc377 context_enriched precedent. It needs host approval in fixture_policy plus a teaching_fixture in the reference; this reviewer did not edit either.

The v6 gate assess(demos, query_input) did not match dispatch. The new gate is require_centred_bridge_evidence(demonstrations, queries, palette=None) and is called with queries=[{'input': grid}]. A test confirms that a poisoned 'output' key is ignored.

Added trim_same and none (bridge through boxes). The canonical train refutes 'none'. trim_same is equivalent to trim_any on native inputs, because the constructor rejects foreign colours in the trimmed rectangle.

subset and expected_boxes are drawn once, outside the while-True loop, and the recursive growth must hit that count exactly. 32/200 draws exceed 5 s (rival_probe run), so the standard 5 s / 50-rejection audit cannot sample this family. The v7 audit uses a 30 s deadline, then redraws and counts the misses (see rejection_stats). Dimensions are not restricted. Proposed host fix, not applied: redraw subset/expected_boxes after K failed geometry attempts. This needs a distribution review.

There is no first/majority/default fallback, no demo skipping, and no D4 choice. Only BG=palette[0] and BR=palette[8] are specialised. Query labels reach verify() only. audit_target passes for all emitted programs.

Painting is on background only, and the one-cell trim is fixed. Any demonstrated bridge refutes other trims, and the solver refuses when no demo shows a bridge. Other exotic rivals (diagonal pairing, nearest-only) are not enumerated.
